items.title: Infants, Parents and Carers Bill
items.description: A Bill to make provision about support for infants, parents and carers of infants, and prospective parents and carers, including provision relating to assessment of needs and to reporting requirements relating to such support; and for connected purposes.

items.title: Medical Services (Rural Areas) Bill
items.description: A Bill to require the Secretary of State to prepare a strategy for expanding the provision of Minor Injuries Units and Urgent Treatment Centres in rural areas; to require the Secretary of State to report to Parliament annually on the implementation of the strategy; and for connected purposes.
categories: Private Members' Bill (under the Ten Minute Rule)

items.title: Housing Bill
items.description: A Bill to establish a target for the annual provision of 150,000 new social homes in England; to require the Secretary of State to report to Parliament on progress in meeting that target; to provide local authorities with further powers relating to social housing, affordable housing, and the right to buy, including to end the right to buy; to make provision for a scheme enabling social housing

items.title: Social Housing Bill [HL]
items.description: A Bill to make provision about social housing.

items.title: Immigration and Asylum Bill
items.description: A Bill to Make provision about immigration, asylum and modern slavery; and for connected purposes.

items.title: Public Office (Accountability) Bill
items.description: A Bill to Impose a duty on public authorities and public officials to act with candour, transparency and frankness; to make provision for the enforcement of that duty in their dealings with inquiries and investigations; to require public authorities to promote and take steps to maintain ethical conduct within all parts of the authority; to create an offence in relation to public authorities and

items.title: Representation of the People Bill
items.description: Make provision extending the right to vote to 16 and 17 year olds; to make provision about the registration of voters; to make provision about the administration and conduct of elections, referendums and recall petitions; to make provision about election agents' addresses; to make provision about political expenditure and political donations; to make provision about information to be included in

items.title: Financial Services and Markets Bill [HL]
items.description: A Bill to make provision about the regulation of financial services and markets; and for connected purposes.

items.title: Health Bill
items.description: A Bill to make provision about health and social care.

items.title: Railways Bill
items.description: A Bill to make provision about railways and railway services; and for connected purposes.

items.title: Malvern Hills Bill [HL]
items.description: A Bill to repeal and re-enact certain enactments relating to the Malvern Hills Conservators and the management of the Malvern Hills, to reconstitute and rename those Conservators as the Malvern Hills Trust and to confer further powers on the Malvern Hills Trust, to make further provision in relation to the Malvern Hills, and for other purposes.

items.title: E-Scooters (Safety and Sale) Bill [HL]
items.description: A Bill to require the Secretary of State to set prescribed safety requirements for e-scooters offered for sale, including limits on speed and power output; to prohibit the marketing, sale and supply of e-scooters for use on roads or other public places where such use is unlawful; to prohibit the sale and supply of equipment capable of modifying an e-scooter to circumvent prescribed safety
categories: Private Members' Bill (Starting in the House of Lords)

items.title: Armed Forces Bill
items.description: A Bill to continue the Armed Forces Act 2006; to amend that Act and other enactments relating to the armed forces; to make provision about the reserve forces; to make provision about visiting forces; to make provision about the Ministry of Defence Police; to make provision about the defence functions of the Oil and Pipelines Agency; to make provision about the protection of military remains; and

items.title: Cyber Security and Resilience (Network and Information Systems) Bill
items.description: A Bill to Make provision, including provision amending the Network and Information Systems Regulations 2018, about the security and resilience of network and information systems used or relied on in connection with the carrying on of essential activities.

items.title: Student Finance (Review) Bill
items.description: A Bill to require the Secretary of State to review student finance in England; to require the review to consider loan repayment arrangements and thresholds; to require the review to consider the terms and conditions applying to student loans when they were issued; to require the review to consider the relationship between student finance loan repayment thresholds and average earnings; and for
categories: Private Members' Bill (under the Ten Minute Rule)

items.title: Commercial Payments Bill [HL]
items.description: A bill to make provision about payment terms in commercial contracts; to make provision about interest on late payment of commercial debts; to ban retention clauses in the construction sector; to expand the powers of the Small Business Commissioner in relation to payment disputes and poor payment practices; to amend the Enterprise Act 2016 in connection with other functions of the Small Business

items.title: Sovereign Grant Bill
items.description: A Bill to Specify the amount of the Sovereign Grant for the financial year 2027-28 and the percentage of the income account net surplus of the Crown Estate to be used by the Royal Trustees to determine the amount of the Sovereign Grant in subsequent financial years; to confer a duty and a power on the Treasury to specify the amount of the Sovereign Grant in subsequent financial years in certain

items.title: Domestic Abuse (Pets etc) Bill
items.description: A Bill to make provision about protection for pets and other domestic animals within domestic abuse proceedings, including through non-molestation orders and occupation orders; to amend the definitions of controlling or coercive behaviour and economic abuse to include abuse involving pets and domestic animals; to extend the application of Domestic Abuse Protection Orders to cover pets and

items.title: Church Appointments (Repeal of Discriminatory Provision) Bill
items.description: A Bill to Repeal provision which prohibits persons of the Roman Catholic or Jewish faiths from advising the Crown on appointments in the Church of England or Church of Scotland; and to repeal provision which precludes such persons from making ecclesiastical appointments.

items.title: Planning and Development (Community Infrastructure) Bill
items.description: A Bill to require housing developers to construct any planned community infrastructure before commencing construction of housing with which the planned community infrastructure is associated; and for connected purposes.

items.title: Barbers and Hairdressers (Registration) Bill
items.description: A Bill to make provision for the compulsory registration of barbers and hairdressers in England.

items.title: Rural Communities (Public Services and Energy) Bill
items.description: A Bill to require the Secretary of State to carry out a review of the adequacy of local government funding for rural communities, and to require that review to consider the additional costs of delivering public services in sparsely populated areas; to require the Secretary of State to carry out a review of access to healthcare services for rural communities, and to require that review to consider

items.title: Courts and Tribunals Bill
items.description: A Bill to Make provision in relation to criminal courts in England and Wales; to make provision about the leadership of tribunals; to amend section 1 of the Children Act 1989 to remove the presumption relating to the involvement of parents in the life of a child; and for connected purposes.

items.title: Sale and Supply of Glue Traps (Prohibition) Bill
items.description: A Bill to prohibit the sale and supply of glue traps other than to a person with a glue trap licence; and for connected purposes.

items.title: Multi-Storey Car Parks (Safety) Bill
items.description: A Bill to increase the minimum required height of guarding in multi-storey car parks; to make provision about the height of guarding in existing multi-storey car parks; to require 24-hour staffing of multi-storey car parks; and for connected purposes.
